query:
SELECT day,
                      (swipes_right + swipes_left + swipes_up + swipes_down)::int8 AS "swipes!",
                      searches::int8 AS "searches!"
               FROM user_daily_activity
               WHERE user_id = $1
                 AND day > $2::date - $3::int4
                 AND swipes_right + swipes_left + swipes_up + swipes_down + searches > 0
               ORDER BY day
